profile_text.body:
Microsoft is a publicly traded technology company founded in 1975 and headquartered in Redmond, WA. Its website, as captured through the Power Automate product page, describes the company as offering workflow and business process automation across apps, systems, and websites using AI-powered, digital, and robotic process automation. A customer testimonial on the site states that a process previously requiring over 100 people to validate and standardize carrier data can now be managed by just a few people using generative AI and Power Automate.

Microsoft's tracked AI portfolio spans several categories. Power Automate AI is described as an enterprise workflow automation tool with Copilot integration, M365 data access, and data loss prevention integration. Microsoft Copilot is embedded across Microsoft 365. Azure OpenAI Service delivers OpenAI models within Azure regions with enterprise content filtering, Entra ID integration, and data residency controls. Azure Machine Learning provides an MLOps platform with AutoML, a model registry, and responsible AI toolkit integration. Additional products include AutoGen, a multi-agent conversation framework developed through Microsoft Research, Microsoft Designer for image and design generation, Microsoft Teams AI for meeting recaps and Copilot integration, SharePoint AI for enterprise content, and Microsoft Clipchamp AI for video editing with auto-caption and text-to-speech capabilities.

On the litigation side, Microsoft is a named defendant in The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI, filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York, and is associated with the related Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc. matter in the same court. Microsoft's SEC filings are recorded under CIK 0000789019 and ticker MSFT, with the most recently verified annual revenue of $331,839,000,000 for the period ending June 30, 2026, reported on Form 10-K.
